svg.title: One question, two calls
svg.desc: Question: What is the stock coverage in France in June 2026? The agent picks month June 2026, filter France, basis kg or L equivalent. STOCK_COVERAGE refuses with BASIS_NOT_COMPARABLE: Coverage is always in months, but on QTY_EQ at least one row or total adds kg and L (items of different dimensions), so stock and forecast cannot be summed for this request. Bases allowed for this request: VALUE. The agent calls again on value (EUR); the procedure sums the stock and forecast of France's standard items and computes the coverage once: 8.7 months. The agent's answer begins: France's stock coverage in June 2026 is about 8.7 months.
svg.metadata:
{"answer": "France's stock coverage in June 2026 is about 8.7 months. On that basis, the stock runs out around March 2027. The figure compares stock at standard cost (about €28.4M) with the next 24 months of forecast cost of goods sold (about €77.1M).

I used the value basis (EUR) because the usual kg/L-equivalent basis was refused. France's items mix kg and L, so those units can't be added together.

Two warnings came back:
- **FORECAST_GAPS_FILLED (20):** 20 item-months in the forecast horizon had no forecast row, so they were counted as zero demand.
- **DEFAULT_SCOPE_EXCLUDED:** About €15.45M of BULK stock was left out because it has no forecast. Including it would require filtering item type explicitly.

Bases allowed for this request: VALUE.", "refusal": "BASIS_NOT_COMPARABLE", "scope": ["STANDARD"], "second_basis": "VALUE", "units": ["kg", "L"], "value": 8.700920093442502}
